honesty: Fixture/synthetic ranked suite (n_ranked design ≥24×seeds). Not held_out promotion. Anti-E237 bar requires held_out n≥20. Runtime is a first-class endpoint (wall_ms_mean, quality_per_ms). Metrics and scorer params loaded from versioned resources (config_resources).

runtime.decision_path: per-arm independent: project_program_factors + build_factor_representation + score + select
runtime.note: decision_ms is the first-class runtime metric for efficiency. Slight quality loss can be preferred if wall_ms_mean is ~100× lower.
